entries.title: I Peter 5:1
segments: ¶I who am myself one of the rulers of the church, and a witness of the death of Christ, having my part in the coming glory, send this serious request to the chief men among you:

entries.title: I Peter 5:2
segments: Keep watch over the flock of God which is in your care, using your authority, not as forced to do so, but gladly; and not for unclean profit but with a ready mind;

entries.title: I Peter 5:3
segments: Not as lords over God's heritage, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

entries.title: I Peter 5:4
segments: And at the coming of the chief Keeper of the sheep, you will be given the eternal crown of glory.

entries.title: I Peter 5:5
segments: ¶And in the same way, let the younger men be ruled by the older ones. Let all of you put away pride and make yourselves ready to be servants: for God is a hater of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low.

entries.title: I Peter 5:6
segments: For this cause make yourselves low under the strong hand of God, so that when the time comes you may be lifted up;

entries.title: I Peter 5:7
segments: Putting all your troubles on him, for he takes care of you.

entries.title: I Peter 5:8
segments: ¶Be serious and keep watch; the Evil One, who is against you, goes about like a lion with open mouth in search of food;

entries.title: I Peter 5:9
segments: Do not give way to him but be strong in your faith, in the knowledge that your brothers who are in the world undergo the same troubles.

entries.title: I Peter 5:10
segments: ¶And after you have undergone pain for a little time, the God of all grace who has given you a part in his eternal glory through Christ Jesus, will himself give you strength and support, and make you complete in every good thing;

entries.title: I Peter 5:11
segments: His is the power for ever. So be it.

entries.title: I Peter 5:12
segments: I have sent you this short letter by Silvanus, a true brother, in my opinion; comforting you and witnessing that this is the true grace of God; keep to it.

entries.title: I Peter 5:13
segments: She who is in Babylon, who has a part with you in the purpose of God, sends you her love; and so does my son Mark.

entries.title: I Peter 5:14
segments: Give one another the kiss of love. Peace be to you all in Christ.
